title: Every declared bound is exercised and fails closed
statement: T020 must exercise every declared DecodeLimits bound, byte/depth/node/string and each decoded-entity cap, at, below, and above its declared value; a limit below 1 must fail closed with XCOM-DECODE-UNKNOWN; and no bound breach may return a decoded value.
applicability: X-Verse capability 007 bounded decoder; T019 declared DecodeLimits caps, no production value fixed.
verification_intent: Refined by T020-SR-004; verified by the T20BoundMatrix CTest cases and the repository bound-derivation pytest case.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: for each bound an input within the bound is accepted and an input over the bound is failed XCOM-DECODE-BOUND, except an over-length string which is rejected XCOM-DECODE-SHAPE, with no decoded value in either breach case.
AC-2: every DecodeLimits member exercised with the value 0 is failed XCOM-DECODE-UNKNOWN.
AC-3: the bound-matrix cases are finite, bounded, and deterministic and fix no production numeric value.
